document_type: Aternal Senia planning registry - NOT game runtime data
business_strategy: Full Content Launch. No public mini roster test. QA internally, then full release.
runtime_rules: Stable existing IDs, do not overwrite game/data/catalog.json or save v12. New IDs are planning IDs until reviewed.
hero_rarity_policy_proposal: All hero entry rarity 5 stars as baseline if preserving current mechanics; separate awakening, no paid-exclusive combat heroes. Review before code.
disclaimer: Combat effects and loot are conceptual, numerical values and actual drop IDs to be specified in balance sheets, not final.

bosses.name: Dawn Colossus
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Layered protective shields and visible armor weakpoint
bosses.story_cause: Broken beacon commands cause a defensive sentinel to misidentify friends as foes
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Repair the beacon and retrieve Dawnvale seal

bosses.name: Furnace Monarch
bosses.story_cause: A forge-core absorbs Rift energy and overheats
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Evacuate workers, stabilize furnace, retrieve fire seal

bosses.name: Mirror Leviathan
bosses.story_cause: The sea gate guardian is driven mad by distorted reflections
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Dispel mirrors, open sea route and retrieve water seal

bosses.name: Briar Matriarch
bosses.story_cause: Forest protector mistakes all visitors for threats to the source spring
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Protect water source and restore the forest seal

bosses.name: Storm Roc
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Charged dive telegraph and interruption window
bosses.story_cause: Storm bird suffers from a sabotaged relay signal
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Restore aerial relay and acquire storm seal

bosses.name: Night Archivist
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Summon pages and temporary silence with clear counters
bosses.story_cause: Keeper of stolen relics refuses to release the shadow seal
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Break the illegal vault and retrieve shadow seal

bosses.name: Astral Warden
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Three phases mixing telegraphs learned across regions
bosses.story_cause: Final sentinel tests whether the seven seals can be wielded safely
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Clear three phases and close the Rift

bosses.name: Ironbound Titan
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Heavy armor breaking and stagger timing
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Farm Iron Resolve gear and forging materials

bosses.name: Obsidian Basilisk

bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Farm Deep Current gear and accessory parts

bosses.name: Eclipse Serpent
bosses.encounter_mechanic: Poison stacks and clearable shadow hazards
bosses.story_or_reward_consequence: Farm Phoenix Crest fragments while practicing cleanse

bosses.name: Rift Devourer

bosses.name: Starfall Hydra
